item.title: Core Balance
item.lead: This concluding page summarizes the editorial stance without presenting the source claims as independently proven facts.

items: The dossier interprets adult-tech as a socio-technical system, not merely as a collection of individual transactions.
The core concepts are commodification, alienation, scalability, CRM profiles, and the substitution of physical for digital proximity.
The VHEMT link is a philosophical synthesis and must be distinguished as a hypothesis from empirically proven causality.
The strongest path for further research is triangulation between documents, technical artifacts, and independent sociological data.

blocks.label: SOURCE STATUS
blocks.text: This PDF is substantively derived from the sections on industrialized exploitation, VHEMT, societal weaponization, demographic implosion, and research triangulation in the submitted dossier. This Research Edition 4.0 adds current public source verification as of September 19, 2026, and explicitly marks which figures/claims from the source material have not been independently verified.

Guidance for further research. The source itself mentions legal documentation, technical data, and sociological analysis as three tracks for triangulation. In this edition, these tracks have been brought together as an editorial structure; they have not been externally verified.
